presentation.speaker: henri_dubois
presentation.title: Housekeeping strike
lines: Your housekeepers are threatening to walk out over the rota.

choices.label: Pay a $350 settlement bonus each
choices.outcome: The team stays and no rooms are lost.

choices.label: Hire replacement cleaners
choices.outcome: Cleaning capacity drops to sixty percent for six days.

choices.label: Hold firm
choices.outcome: Cleaning nearly stops for ten days and morale falls.
